chunks.rationale: The split-tree operations are the whole feature; read paneLayout.test.ts first so the UI is just a renderer of those ops. Then paneWorkspace.test.tsx (close/Cmd+\/drag) and the Views menu cases in threadHeader.test.tsx.
risks: jsdom has no DragEvent; drag-swap is exercised via a module-level draggingPaneId plus generic Event('dragstart'|'drop')
unmountAll now wipes coder.paneLayout.* keys so tests cannot observe persistence across remounts — that path is covered only at the model layer

chunks.rationale: paneLayout.ts is the contract: binary split tree, open/close/resize/move, parse fallback, per-thread localStorage. Wrong close-last or extract logic loses a pane or the whole tree.
risks: close of the last leaf is a no-op; an empty workspace is impossible on purpose
movePane extract+insert can no-op if the target leaf vanished with the extract (should not happen for a different leaf)
1 - MIN_RATIO is not 0.82 in IEEE; MAX_RATIO is a separate constant

chunks.rationale: PaneWorkspace renders the tree; ThreadView owns layout state, the Views menu, and maps chat/diff onto existing surfaces. Exclusive Thread|Git tabs are gone: chat and Git can share the center pane.
risks: changesOpen is now an open-signal (Environment / next-git), not exclusive visibility — App still zeros it on thread switch, but persisted layouts restore Git independently
first-mount must not re-hydrate or it drops a changesOpen:true Git pane; only real thread switches reload from storage
PaneWorkspace .body was renamed leafBody because CSS-module tests stub class names as the key and query('.body') would hit the wrapper, breaking stick-to-bottom
Git ChangesPanel still paints its own header under the pane chrome when split — duplicate 'Git' title

chunks.rationale: KeyboardSheet gained ⌘ + \ . No PRODUCT-SPEC change; terminal/browser/files/tasks/subagent are registry placeholders until those issues land.
risks: Cmd+\ is renderer-only; it is not in the Electron View menu
Sidebar and Agents stay app chrome — they are not pane types. Putting them in the tree later would fight the narrow-window drawers.
Layout lives in localStorage (coder.paneLayout.<threadId>), not coder-store.json. Multi-window shares it; a store migration is out of scope.
No browser verification of drag/resize; jsdom has no layout.
